name: Tesseract
author: E. T. Carter
description: A hypercube as a blue hologram, thrown up from a projector on a slim post: thirty-two edges of light and sixteen bright corners, seen in perspective through the fourth dimension as a cube within a cube. It turns a quarter turn at a time, eased in and held, the inner cube flowing out to become the outer one, then twisting through itself. Scanlines drift up it, a bright band sweeps through, it flickers, and now and then a glitch shears it sideways in slices.

sculpture.label: A four-dimensional cube as a blue hologram, turning a quarter turn at a time: the inner cube flows out to become the outer one, then it twists through itself.

params.label: Pace
params.effect: How fast it steps from turn to turn: 1 takes three and a half seconds to turn and holds as long.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: How deep the fourth dimension looks: 0 flattens the two cubes into one, higher pulls the inner one smaller.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: Turntable speed: 1 is one turn a minute; 0 holds it.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer orbits the camera round the piece; 0 ignores the mouse.
